response.sql:
WITH acct_avg AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(CAST(amount AS REAL)) AS avg_amount
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM acct_avg
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       a.avg_amount,
       a.avg_amount - o.mean_avg AS diff_from_mean
FROM acct_avg a
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE a.avg_amount > o.mean_avg
ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The mean is taken over accounts that appear in trans. Accounts with no transactions have no row to average, so they are excluded from the mean and from the results.
trans.account_id is the account key for grouping. The request names it explicitly, so the partner column trans.account is not used.
Every transaction's stored amount is used unsigned, as the request specifies, so the undocumented VYBER rows are included with no direction applied.
The per-account mean is cast to REAL so the averages keep their fractional part on engines that truncate integer AVG. The SQL assumes a SQLite-style engine that supports CTEs and LIMIT.
